purpose: EPIC-021 minimal cross-host capability manifest, updated through INIT-009 EPIC-022/023/026 and INIT-010 EPIC-020. It records, per host, what surface each capability has, through what channel it is reached, and the governance level TCRN can honestly claim today. A level describes the shipped boundary, not whether an operator has installed or registered it in a particular host.

governanceLevels.enforce: TCRN can block or gate the capability before it takes effect
governanceLevels.observe: TCRN records the capability fail-open, without blocking
governanceLevels.invoke-only: the capability can be called, but TCRN cannot yet observe or gate it
governanceLevels.unavailable: no TCRN integration exists for this capability on this host yet

claude.note: live and measured: reversible, fail-open, 1024-byte read-only summary (claude-code.json)

codex.note: live and measured on Codex CLI 0.139.0: one project-local startup|resume fail-open hook injected the exact digest-bound v2 Verity/capability summary through hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext; installation receipt remains pending while a separate host-activation receipt records approval and fire

claude.note: surface exists; any hook beyond SessionStart is gated on the N-2 amendment (S072) before it may be added

codex.note: observe handler exists, but Codex activation deliberately registers only SessionStart; PostToolUse remains gated per hook

claude.note: enforce-class; gated on S072 N-2 amendment and a failure-policy ruling

codex.note: the App Server protocol exposes ExecCommand/ApplyPatch/FileChange/Permissions approvals; the shipped Observer never responds to them and no enforce gate exists

the read-only Observer and S054 collector bind supplied spawn/thread/turn/final-message notifications to session/thread/turn receipts. A real Codex Desktop 0.146.0-alpha.3.1 run now proves App-visible sub_agent_activity and completed subagent rollouts, but those rollout records are not the pinned App Server notification stream; no live attach or Workflow receipt comparison is claimed

claude.note: the host-neutral Workflow MCP server gates mutations through pinned operator authority; host registration remains an operator action

codex.note: the host-neutral server is registered and enabled, and the exact candidate completed direct initialize, tools/list and read-only status with pinned authority; mutations remain gated. The running Desktop process did not hot-load it and a fresh CLI host-routed attempt hit the account usage limit before a tool call

install/deactivate are identity-gated; the exact current development candidate was installed, separately approved and live-fired after a governed rollback rehearsal. Installation alone never claims host activation, Codex's trust hash is opaque, and exact-definition changes require reapproval

sessionBinding.note: the minimal binding a live session must carry, defined here as the contract EPIC-022's MCP admission and any observer receipt will populate. Attribution is not identity proof.
sessionBinding.digestOf: the canonical bytes of this manifest's `capabilities` array, so a session declares which capability baseline it was admitted against

compatibilityMatrix.note: which surfaces each host exposes, and whether TCRN reaches them today. 'yes' means a surface exists to integrate; the governance level per capability above says whether that integration is built.

rows.tcrnGoverned: yes at the Workflow MCP boundary; host registration is operator-owned
Claude and Codex SessionStart (live observe); Codex Desktop subagents are App-visible, while the App Server collector remains supplied-stream only

notClaimed: no enforce-level host lifecycle or host-tool governance exists; enforce is limited to Workflow MCP mutations at the server boundary
no host approval or internal trust hash is inferred from a Codex installation receipt
no live App Server attach, Controller, or approval responder is claimed
App-visible Codex Desktop multi-agent records exist but have not been converted to or compared with a Workflow execution receipt
no hot-load into the running Codex Desktop process or successful host-routed Workflow MCP call is claimed
governance levels are a snapshot of 2026-07-25 against Codex 0.139.0 and the measured Claude Code 2.1.201 activation
